title: Pan-Seared Australian Lamb Chops
description: Tender and flavorful Australian lamb chops, pan-seared to perfection and served with a side of roasted vegetables. This dish is perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.

ingredients.name: roasted earthy vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, potatoes, and parsnips

instructions: Preheat a skillet or cast-iron pan over medium-high heat.
Season the lamb chops with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder (if using).
Add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat.
Sear the lamb chops for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the lamb chops to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Add the roasted earthy vegetables to the pan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
Serve the lamb chops with the roasted vegetables on the side.
